$comment: CI seconds per test file (fork start, import, collection and tests, as FileDurationsReporter records them) that durationShards in @al-ft/midgard-test-support packs --shard by, and withDurationTier in @al-ft/midgard-test-support/vitest splits into the fast tier and the slow tier (files at or over SLOW_TIER_FILE_SECONDS). Each file is what Node CI run 45037768081 (commit d21481177) measured: the one run since snapshot admission stopped decoding each transaction once per history unit, which shortened the dispute files; one run's records carry its runners' speeds, so refresh from the median of several once there are more. forksPerShard is the CI fork cap (MIDGARD_FAULT_PROOF_FORKS). reservedSeconds is the traced-refusal step that shards 1 and 2 run after their tests, one Vitest project each: in run 45043324915 the interactive-emulator project's runs took 2,873 s and the testing-profile project's 1,674 s, four at a time, plus building the overlays. Refresh with demo/midgard-test-support/scripts/ci-file-durations.mjs --run <id> --run <id> ..., or take the ci-file-durations artifact of any Node CI run. A stale or missing entry only costs shard balance, or leaves a newly slow file in the fast tier until the next refresh, never coverage.
